content: {"like":["Values high-quality visual and audio restoration, especially in Criterion releases; appreciates detailed extras and insightful commentary; enjoys strong, charismatic performances and vibrant, stylized cinematography; favors films with sharp, suspenseful pacing and effective use of music; prefers accessible, well-priced editions with region flexibility."],"dislike":["Dislikes technical flaws in early releases (sound, syncing, pressing issues); rejects content that feels gratuitous or misogynistic; is critical of plot holes, logical lapses, and overused tropes; avoids films with excessive gore or sexual content that lack substantive depth; steers clear of poorly executed dubbing or low-quality physical media."]}
